title: jointly braised ukrainian lamb tagine
description: hearty, comforting ukrainian dish featuring ground coriander in a rich, slow-cooked lamb stew. perfect for a chilly weeknight dinner.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large clay tajine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. remove from the pot and set aside.
reduce the heat to medium and add the onion to the pot. cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 8 minutes.
add the garlic, caraway seeds, ground coriander, smoked paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot. cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
add the beef broth, red wine vinegar, and browned lamb shoulder to the pot.
bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
remove the pot from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley.
serve the lamb and sauce over egg noodles or rice.
garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
